headline: Vijayapura reports 46,434 severely stunted children and 2,004 underage pregnancies, reflecting deep nutritional crisis
summary: Vijayapura district faces acute child malnutrition with 46,434 severely stunted children recorded at Anganwadi centres, the second-highest in Karnataka. The district was among eight identified for eggs in midday meals due to severe malnutrition. Additionally, 2,004 underage pregnancy cases were reported in 2023, linked to child marriage and poor maternal health. These figures reflect systemic challenges in nutrition, maternal care, and health access that perpetuate stunting in one of Karnataka's most affected districts.

reasons.detail: Vijayapura recorded 2,004 underage pregnancies in 2023, among the highest in Karnataka, indicating poor maternal health outcomes that directly impact child nutrition.
The district has 46,434 severely stunted children, prompting government intervention through egg supplementation in midday meals to address acute nutritional deficiency.
Healthcare access challenges are evidenced by food safety lapses, with eight children falling ill from spoiled eggs at an Anganwadi centre in Basavana Bagewadi taluk.
Vijayapura was included in eight districts receiving eggs three days weekly in midday meals specifically to combat malnutrition and stunting among school children.
